isolated_mutation_setup: Copy the source to an owned scratch directory's src/singular_check.py and tests to tests/test_singular_check.py; use mutmut-config.toml as pyproject.toml. Use the repository compute.sh by its path from that directory; no symlinks or installations are needed.
targeted: Each launcher-target-NAME.diff changes only the copied source. Run the five native pytest methods in that isolated directory after a clean control; their complete named failure outputs are preserved. Restore the source between variants.
scope: Complete CLI and API output, live diagnostics, asserted failure, completed token and flushed received lines; no mathematical proof or all-CAS completion inference.
